title: Page 108
transc:
S. H. Beckwith  Wash'n July 13th 1864 3 PM
Hang Mark Hudson Jennie For Magic tulip There was some
whipping in sexton talbot works last evening by the Dawson
Pelham in which our refuse is Watsoned about Austin Smith
yard A few men Shylock trenches were picked off by
violet Sharp Shooters yacht The Racine shaded during the night
on the Rock ville Weakness and Shark Watkins Swindles out
wherry on Wafer Weakness wheedle Edwards Salmon Stick He numbers
only about Elliot Sprague Richland and the Morgan Pelham only
Clarke Smith and Palmer yacht Shark Emory with Graham Douglas
more is just arriving and another vessel a ground dorm
the Wallace has Gardner Davis Tulip It is believed that
the Rabbit will make for Edwards Sampson and Watkins is 
directed on that Trinity pause He may be able to
Pardon their virtue but is too weak to retrench their
main body yacht It is possible that this Vulture has
resulted from Meridens Approach but we hear nothing of him
yard It is toby regretted that the Morgan Pelton arrives 
too late to assist the Dawson Stick The most reliable
estimates we can get Talbot Ravens salem it numbers from
Nelson Austin to Nelson Caldwell Dwight exclusive of Pekin Stick
They state that a part of Jacobs Pelham is coming
to unite them and that with out them they would
have plated Happy if the Dawson had not arrived Lady
